More information
Luxury fed by nature
The Living Circle is a hand-picked group of first-class hotels and restaurants in incomparably beautiful locations, run by dedicated hosts. Rice, vegetables, fruit and a whole array of exquisite products including wine, of course is whisked fresh from our own farms directly to your table. That is how we define luxury. That is The Living Circle luxury fed by nature.

The beauty of nature, a deliberately authentic life style plus the utmost in comfort – we promise you all this and more at our Resort.

Wellbeing
The 41 junior suites and suites as well as 38 double and single rooms spread over three parts of the building exude quiet luxury and plenty of privacy. With different layouts and furnishings, the rooms and suites combine high quality and cosiness to create the luxurious feeling of living at Castello del Sole.
The rooms and suites in the main building are decorated with Mediterranean colours and lightness. At your feet is a well-tended park that leads to a private beach on the shores of Lake Maggiore.
The Retreat Pavilion - an architectural jewel in the Lombardy country house style. The centrepiece is the rose garden in the inner courtyard. The view of the surrounding rice fields makes you dream. Discover an oasis of peace and beauty
The spacious suites and junior suites in the Wellbeing Pavilion promise an impressive sense of space. Take a deep breath and let go. The wellbeing area is located in the same building for a seamless experience of luxury and relaxation.

Our Story
A rich and varied past
Authenticity defines our essence and enduring values shape our identity: Castello del Sole is more than just a home; it is a living story that we continue to weave together with you. Let us begin this journey from the very beginning: Francesco Orelli built the Castello del Sole in 1532, originally as a sanctuary for followers of the new Protestant doctrine. Documented for the first time in 1756 as an architectural "jewel", around 1900 it was a modest six-room osteria. In the decades that followed, it was transformed into an exclusive hotel, preserving its distinctive features while embracing contemporary luxury.
Simon V. Und Gabriela Jenny
"Our history is an integral part of our culture, it documents the past and influences the future. It is therefore fascinating and a great privilege to manage the only resort in Switzerland with its own winery, Cantina alla Maggia, and to lead it together into a successful future. ."
